mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_employee_binding b JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = b.sys_user_id AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' JOIN vi_station_grant g ON g.sys_user_id = u.user_id AND g.station_id = #{stationId} AND g.enabled = 1 JOIN vi_station s ON s.id = g.station_id JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id AND d.status = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE b.account_id = #{accountId} AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.revoked_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = '0' WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND FIND_IN_SET(#{permission}, REPLACE(m.perms, ' ', '')) > 0 AND ( r.data_scope = '1' OR (r.data_scope = '2' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_dept rd WHERE rd.role_id = r.role_id AND rd.dept_id = s.dept_id)) OR (r.data_scope IN ('3', '4') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_dept ud JOIN sys_dept member_dept ON member_dept.dept_id = ud.dept_id AND member_dept.status = '0' AND member_dept.del_flag = '0' WHERE ud.user_id = u.user_id AND (ud.dept_id = s.dept_id OR (r.data_scope = '4' AND FIND_IN_SET(ud.dept_id, d.ancestors) > 0)))) ) )
